The Galaxy's Most Wanted is a hard box, and now you can choose to even it out. A new Balanced option eases the campaign's three worst scenarios. Heroic and Skirmish arrive from the Rules Reference, for when you want it harder or shorter. Every campaign's Briefing gets its box art, and there are 46 new trophies to chase, most of them ideas from players.

The Galaxy Is Unfair

Issue #609 · PR #610 · Requested by Borja · Fixes by Gideon's Gaming

The Galaxy's Most Wanted is known for being swingy, and punishing at low player counts. Starting the campaign now asks how you want to play it. Play as normal is the default, and it plays exactly as the cards are written. Rebalance the campaign is an opt-in house rule, unofficial and locked for the whole run. It takes its fixes from Gideon's Gaming's write-up, which the screen credits and links.

The Museum

  • Collector's redirect catches player cards only, so encounter cards discard as usual.

Nebula

  • Once per round, 3 or more damage from one attack on Nebula removes an evasion counter from her ship.
  • With one hero, The Art of Evasion breaks at 12.

Ronan

  • No Kree Command Ship, and main schemes start with no threat and accelerate 1 per hero.
  • Universal Weapon starts in the encounter deck.
  • The group picks free Milano Mods nobody bought, attached for that scenario.

Want some challenge back?

  • Space Pirates in the Museum, with their removals going to The Collection.
  • Expert Gallery of Splendor in the Museum deck, for 3 or more players in standard.
  • The Museum's Standard set trimmed to Shadow of the Past.
  • Milano Mods can't be used while the Milano is exhausted.
  • Kree Supremacy in Ronan's deck, with 2 or more heroes.

It costs you nothing

  • Full points and full credit, Expert Campaign included.
  • Beating a Balanced run earns The Galaxy Is Unfair, worth 100 points.
  • @bluefireF5ran edited the scans, in English and Spanish, so the cards on the table match the house rule.

Heroic and Skirmish

Issue #611 by @zackburnley · PR #612

Two more ways to play from the Rules Reference, and they combine with Expert however you like. Pick them on Set the table, or for one campaign issue under Modes for this issue on the Briefing. A game can be Expert Heroic 2 Skirmish, and that's what the footer, Pause and Game over will call it.

Heroic

  • Level 1 to 4 deals that many extra encounter cards to each player in every villain phase.
  • It doesn't add the Expert set. It only adds cards.
  • Cards go around the table one at a time, and each player reveals them in the order dealt.

Skirmish

  • Play one version of the villain and remove the rest, so defeating it wins the game.
  • Loki, Mansion Attack and the Four Horsemen get a plain switch that uses the rulebook's own rule.
  • Kang, Apocalypse, The God of Lies and other multi-villain scenarios don't offer it.
  • A Skirmish win is a win, but not an Expert win for unlocks or achievements.

Box art on every Briefing

Issue #613 · PR #614

Every campaign's Briefing now has a colored pane with that box's art faded behind it, the same pane as the Balanced choice. Your decks sit on paper inside it on tablet and desktop, and on a phone it stacks with the rest of the page.

Make it yours

  • Faded art on campaign pages in Settings turns the art off.
  • Fade color picks grey, blue, red, purple or green.

45 more trophies

Issue #615 by @PermaKarma · PR #617

@PermaKarma sent in a list of trophy ideas, and they all made it in. The Trophy Room has two new families and a much longer team-up list. They read your saved games, so wins you already have count the moment you update.

Doppelgangers

Beat a villain with the hero of the same name seated: Nebula, Venom, Magneto, Black Widow and all six Civil War leaders. All ten earn Hall of Mirrors.

Arch-enemies

Twelve grudges settled, like Hail No for Captain America against Red Skull and Get Help for Thor against Loki. All twelve earn Every Score Settled.

Team-ups

Win with both heroes of a pair seated. All 21 pairs open their team-up art in Extras ▸ Artwork. Rocket and Groot's is called We Are Groot.

New trophies raise the top of the rank ladder, because rank 9 still takes everything. If you sit just above a rank's line, you may show one rank lower until these trophies count for you. Nothing in the game depends on rank.

You asked, we fixed

PR #607 by @bluefireF5ran · PR #610

The first five are @bluefireF5ran's rules audit follow-ups, so the game plays closer to the Rules Reference and FFG's rulings.

Breakout · The Wrecking Crew

"The villain" means the active one

A player card that names the villain now means the active villain, with no choice of villain.

Insert, "The Active Villain" · FFG ruling Jun 13, 2024
Piercing

Piercing hits the right character

Damage dealt as indirect or divided pierces only the attacked character. Everyone else keeps their tough status cards.

RRG 1.8 pp. 24, 32
Lasting effects

A new copy starts clean

Goliath's +4 ATK until the end of the phase no longer applies once the card leaves play and comes back as a new copy.

Enemy choices

One target, no question

A choice the enemy team must make with one legal target, like Colleen Wing or Daredevil, resolves without asking the first player.

Quickstrike and teamwork

Wait your turn

An activation started inside an enemy's activation always waits for that activation to finish, even when nothing follows the effect that put the minion into play.

RRG 1.8 p. 6
Card scans

No more generated frames

A scan missing from a build now falls back to the normal scan rather than a generated frame.
